content.comment_body: Good afternoon. Is there a way to reset the [product_name]? I lost the password for [product_name] software and can no longer access the [product_name]. I tried using the toolbar to transfer or reset to factory settings, but it still requests the password. I deleted the program on the device, but I'm still unable to proceed. Is there another way to restore factory settings? The [product_name] is [version_no] [version_no].

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. As a reminder, this forum operates in English, so please post future messages in English. If your [product_name] has a display, you can initiate a factory reset from the device menu: Go to the menu, switch to Stop mode, enter Setup, and confirm with OK. Choose Factory Reset, confirm, select Yes, and press OK.

One method is to create a simple program on your [product_name] without a password, save it to a memory card, and insert the card into your device before powering it on. Afterward, you can use [product_name] software or an operator panel to complete the factory reset. Hope this helps.
This approach won't work because password protection for software and web access is set via access control, and these settings are stored in the device—not in the program.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble resetting their [product_name] ([version_no]) after forgetting the password for [product_name] software. Deleting the device program or trying resets through the toolbar doesn't bypass the password requirement. The community suggests hardware-based resets using the device display or memory cards, but note that password protection is stored in the device hardware and these methods may have limitations.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to be able to reset the [product_name] device to factory settings without needing the forgotten password, seeking either software or hardware solutions.
